t: You're at St Mary Moorfields, a Roman Catholic church on Eldon Street, near Moorgate. It stands on a site once known as Moorfields, and it's the only Catholic church in the City of London. Until a boundary change in 1994 it counted as part of Hackney, so the City had no Catholic church at all. The architect George Campbell Sherrin designed it. He also designed Moorgate station and worked on Old Spitalfields Market. The Spanish naval officer Felipe Bauzá is buried here.
